summary: Architecture-review-only continuation of Track B: Repository Intelligence. Reviews the five Track B architecture documents from 118A through 118E and concludes that the architecture set is coherent and ready for contract freeze with minor clarifications. Confirms Repository Knowledge as the foundation, Historical Memory as temporal layer, Dependency Knowledge Graph as relationship layer, Change Impact Analysis as read-only change-scoped reasoning, and Advisory Reasoning Expansion as a non-authoritative consumer. Documents confirmed decisions, boundary review, terminology review, primitive compatibility, source attribution, determinism, uncertainty/conflict/supersession handling, verification, versioning/snapshot concepts, integrations, no-go boundaries, risks, required clarifications, and recommends 119A - Repository Intelligence Contract Freeze. No contracts, extraction, graph construction, impact engine, advisory behavior, evidence subsystem, repository skills, decision evaluation, source, test, runtime behavior, execution, enforcement, lifecycle, Permission Broker, REST, Dashboard, Web UI, provider orchestration, autonomous coding, automatic patch generation, automatic refactoring, or Telegram inbound changes.
